name: crossway_troublemakers_attacking_vampires_deathtouch_and_lifelink
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Attacking Vampires you control have deathtouch and lifelink. Whenever a Vampire you control dies, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.' Seat 0 attacks with Crossway Troublemakers (5/5, unblocked), a Vampire (2/2) blocked by Opp Giant (5/5) and a Bear (2/2, not a Vampire) blocked by Opp Ox (3/3). The Vampire's 2 damage kills the Giant (deathtouch) and gains 2 (lifelink); the Troublemakers gain 5; the Bear neither kills the Ox nor gains life. The Vampire dies: seat 0 pays 2 life and draws a card. The Bear dies too, not a Vampire: nothing. Seat 0: 20 + 5 + 2 - 2 = 25; seat 1: 15.
